announcements.title: Donate to your mosque
announcements.content:
Taleem Mosque, it’s your Mosque.

Situated in the heart of Grays, we warmly welcome all to connect with their Islamic faith and feel a true sense of community and belonging.

As a registered charity, we deeply appreciate your support in helping us continue to run and grow our community services.

Donate to your Taleem Masjid:

Acc Name - Taleem Foundation
Acc Number - 1044 3584
Acc Sort Code - 60 02 63

Jazakallahu Khairan
